title: triteleia lemmoniae
intro: Triteleia lemmoniae, commonly known as Lemmon's triteleia or mountain bells, is a species of flowering plant in the asparagus family (Asparagaceae). It is used in herbal medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of fever, infection, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Triteleia lemmoniae include its ability to stimulate the immune system and exhibit expectorant properties, making it a potential treatment for coughs and colds. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, alkaloids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
